definitions: to lessen the effectiveness, power, or authority of someone or something gradually

definitions: to strengthen, support, or encourage an idea, structure, or behavioral pattern
examples: The recent survey findings served to reinforce the management belief that employee satisfaction drives productivity.

definitions: to make something less severe, harmful, serious, or painful in its impact
